A study1 found that ifosfamide 8% solution penetrated all of 4 brands of latex glove and one PVC glove, although the diffusion rate was 4 or more times slower than through cadaver skin. Permeation was greater through the PVC glove than the latex gloves, partly due to its lesser thick- ness, although permeation was not dependent on thickness alone and varied between gloves of the same brand as well as between brands.
